answer: For a poll on mapping an opal deposit in the orchard atlas, each ballot carries a refundable $1 deposit. The server randomly audits 10% of ballots; officials compare audited voters and photo IDs with the electoral roll and reject mismatches or repeated IDs, forfeiting their deposits. Other deposits are refunded. If every invalid ballot fails an audit, its expected deposit loss is 10 cents. Unaudited duplicates may count, and ID errors can exclude voters.
